attegrāre ,
I.to pour out wine in sacrifices: attegrare enim est minus facere, ut integrare in statum redigere, Paul. ex Fest. p. 12 Müll. (Festus seems to have written the word ategrare, and to have considered the a as privativum; the Cod. Berol. has also ategrare, Fr.)
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
